description: Victorian Local Government Waste Data Dashboard is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Recycling Victoria. Since 2000, the Victorian Government has surveyed councils about their kerbside collection services (for rubbish, mixed recycling, glass recycling and food organics and garden organics) and other council-related waste services, including the tonnages, costs and composition. The dataset is published annually as an interactive online dashboard and a downloadable CSV data table. In both formats, data is available per council (i.e., Local Government Area). Coverage is the states and territories, 2000 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-10-06. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
